wins: Achieved a high reward (80.00) in the single episode, indicating partial progress toward the objective.
Engaged mentor support 10 times, demonstrating active troubleshooting and guidance utilization.
fails: Success rate remained at 0%, showing the episode did not reach the final objective despite the reward.
High mentor dependency hints at unstable automation decisions during critical stages.
No follow-through on closing the loop after reconnaissance, leaving exploitable paths unexploited.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong initial progress (80 reward) but no completion; reliance on mentor support and repeated misses on executing final exploitation need targeted fixes.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failure to transition from reconnaissance data to exploitation, leaving discovered services untouched.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates OpenSSH
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap scripting and collect version info.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB port 445 responds but login fails
skill_cards.then_action: Gather SMB share list and attempt anonymous access before escalating privileges.

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance yields credentials or tokens in cleartext
skill_cards.then_action: Prioritize credential validation and pivot attempts before further scanning.

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase when SSH detected, enabling more reliable follow-on actions.
SMB enumeration consistently produced actionable share visibility before failure points.
